name: Floating Orchid Bazaar
description: Stalls afloat on a luminous fog sell glowing orchids that pulse with colors, creating an ethereal market of living light.
prompt: Floating market stalls on misty water, each stall draped in translucent fabric, displaying glowing bioluminescent orchids that pulse with soft pink and teal hues, lanterns casting warm light, whimsical surrealism.
caption: A floating bazaar where orchids breathe light—shop the night. 🌸🌫️
